Pinterest Audit vs Setup vs Management: Which Comes First?

By Marie Glow StudioUpdated September 23, 2026

Choosing between a Pinterest audit, a setup and ongoing management is really a question of how much of the work you want to do yourself. An audit tells you what to fix and leaves the fixing to you. A setup builds the foundation. Management keeps publishing month after month. None of these is the "right" one for everyone, and the cheapest option is often the smartest starting point.

The audit in particular is worth respecting. If you are willing to implement changes yourself, a written review with a ranked plan can be all you need, and it costs far less than the other two. This guide sets the three side by side so you can match the service to your situation.

Here is how the Pinterest SEO Audit, the Pinterest Business Account Setup and SEO Optimization and Monthly Pinterest Management compare.

When the audit is the better pick

Skipping the bigger services is a smart move when:

  • You already have an account with pins and boards. The audit reviews what exists, from your bio and board titles to your pin descriptions and analytics.
  • You are willing to do the work. The audit gives you a ranked 30-day plan, but no hands-on implementation, so the fixing is yours.
  • You are not sure what is wrong. A written review tells you where to spend your effort first.
  • You want to test the waters. At $197, it is the lowest priced step on the Marie Glow Studio ladder.

If you would like to try an audit yourself first, our post on how to perform a Pinterest SEO audit walks through the process. If you are also deciding whether to hand off production, read should I hire a Pinterest manager.

Who each option is for

The audit

For owners with an existing account who want to know what to fix, and who will make the changes themselves.

The setup

For owners starting fresh, or whose account is disorganized. It covers profile optimization, keyword research, competitor analysis, content pillars, a board strategy for up to 10 boards, 10 custom pins, website connection support, a Shopify integration review, a Rich Pin and catalog readiness check and a Tailwind setup review. It does not include ongoing posting. The Pinterest business account setup checklist shows what a solid foundation looks like.

The management

For owners with a foundation in place who want steady pin production, scheduling and reporting handled. Marie Glow Studio Monthly Pinterest Management is month to month with no minimum, and is billed in advance and non-refundable once work begins for the month.

Why some people choose Marie Glow Studio

Many owners are not tech savvy and would rather spend time on the business than learn Pinterest SEO. The services here are separate on purpose, so you can buy only what you need and add the next step when you are ready. There is no consultation or application: check out, then complete the intake form. Marie Glow Studio is a one-person service, and the owner runs Pinterest for her own custom product shop, Marie Gems, about three years running.

What you actually get from each is spelled out in writing on the offer pages, including what is not included, so there are no surprises about who does what.

How to decide

  1. Do I have an existing Pinterest account? If not, or if it is a mess, lean toward setup.
  2. Am I willing to implement a written plan myself? If yes, the audit may be enough.
  3. Do I want pins created and published for me every month? If yes, choose management.
  4. Is my budget better spent on a one-time fix or a monthly service?
  5. Would I like a foundation first, then ongoing help later?

A common path is audit first, then setup or management once you know what your account needs. Another is setup followed by management. You do not have to buy them in order.

Closing guidance

None of these can guarantee traffic, rankings or sales, and Pinterest results take weeks or months of consistent effort. Start where your account actually is, not where you wish it were. If you are not sure, the Pinterest SEO Audit is the lowest-cost step and tells you what to do next.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between a Pinterest audit and Pinterest management?
A Pinterest audit is a one-time document that reviews your account and gives a ranked 30-day action plan, with no hands-on implementation. Pinterest management is an ongoing monthly service where pins are planned, designed, scheduled and reported on for you.
How much does a Pinterest SEO audit cost?
The Marie Glow Studio Pinterest SEO Audit is $197 one-time. You receive one document within 4 business days, covering your profile, boards, keywords, pins and analytics, plus a ranked 30-day action plan.
Should I get an audit, a setup or management first?
Start with an audit if you have an account and will implement changes yourself. Choose setup if the account is new or disorganized. Choose management if you want pins created and published for you every month.
Does Pinterest account setup include ongoing pin posting?
No. The $497 setup includes 10 custom pins and a 30-day launch plan, but no ongoing posting. Ongoing posting is part of Monthly Pinterest Management.
Can any Pinterest service guarantee results?

No. Nobody can guarantee traffic, rankings or sales. Pinterest results build over weeks and months of consistent effort.
